title: 雪梨地鐵西北線
summary: 以雪梨地鐵西北線為背景，建立高架、地下與轉乘站交替的自動運轉教學路線。學徒從結構變形追蹤到定位和車門介面，並以不同試驗證據檢查全線服務是否具備可追溯的驗收條件與復原能力。
summaryEn: Use Sydney Metro Northwest as the setting for an automated-operation teaching route alternating elevated, underground and interchange sections. Trace structural movement through localisation and door interfaces. Use different test evidence to check whether the complete service has traceable acceptance conditions and recovery capability, instead of treating successful operation of one train as proof of full-system readiness.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度與沉陷差與軌道坡折
stages.titleEn: Bridge deflection and span sensitivity & Differential settlement and track kink
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」與「沉陷差與軌道坡折」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bridge deflection and span sensitivity" and "Differential settlement and track kink": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bridge deflection and span sensitivity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」如何影響雪梨地鐵西北線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sydney Metro Northwest”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 簡支梁在均布荷載下的撓度對跨長有四次方敏感度，截面慣性矩與材料剛度共同抵抗彎曲。鐵道橋還需要動態與軌道相互作用檢查，靜態梁算例只用來辨認參數量級。 跨長四次方使幾何誤差特別重要，但只有在相同支承、均布荷載及截面條件下才可比較。將毫米轉成公尺後再核對剛度，可避免把量測位移誤差變成材料性能判斷。 在高架跨中與橋端同步量測，辨認橋隧交界的變形來源。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For a simply supported beam under uniform load, deflection scales with the fourth power of span. Section inertia and material stiffness jointly resist bending. A railway bridge also requires dynamic and track-interaction checks; this static beam exercise only reveals parameter magnitudes. Fourth-power span dependence makes geometry important, but comparison requires the same support, uniform-load and section assumptions. Convert millimetres and metres consistently before checking stiffness, so a displacement-unit error does not become a false conclusion about material properties. Measure viaduct midspan and ends together to identify movement sources near a bridge-tunnel transition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：w=50000 N/m; L=26.25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4；計算：deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.103997 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: w=50000 N/m; L=26.25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4; calculation: deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.103997 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度
knowledge.text: 簡支梁在均布荷載下的撓度對跨長有四次方敏感度，截面慣性矩與材料剛度共同抵抗彎曲。鐵道橋還需要動態與軌道相互作用檢查，靜態梁算例只用來辨認參數量級。
knowledge.textEn: For a simply supported beam under uniform load, deflection scales with the fourth power of span. Section inertia and material stiffness jointly resist bending.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bridge deflection and span sensitivity" is correct?
options: 橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成
簡支梁在均布荷載下的撓度對跨長有四次方敏感度，截面慣性矩與材料剛度共同抵抗彎曲。
兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷
optionsEn: Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent.
For a simply supported beam under uniform load, deflection scales with the fourth power of span.
Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them.
quiz.explanation: 簡支梁在均布荷載下的撓度對跨長有四次方敏感度，截面慣性矩與材料剛度共同抵抗彎曲。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For a simply supported beam under uniform load, deflection scales with the fourth power of span. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bridge deflection and span sensitivity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：w=50000 N/m; L=26.25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4；計算：deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.103997 mm。敏感度：L 單獨增加百分之十至 28.875 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.616362 mm。模型邊界：簡支Euler梁、小撓度、靜態均布荷載；不代表列車移動荷載。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: w=50000 N/m; L=26.25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4; calculation: deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.103997 mm. Sensitivity: L, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 28.875 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.616362 mm. Model boundary: Simply supported Euler beam, small deflection and static uniform load; not a moving train-load analysis. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在已知載重位置量測跨中和支點位移，扣除支承沉陷後對照彎矩圖，並用卸載後讀值檢查是否存在殘留變形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure midspan and support movement under known loading, subtract support settlement, compare with the moment diagram, and inspect residual displacement after unloading.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：w=50000 N/m; L=26.25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4；計算：deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.103997 mm。敏感度：L 單獨增加百分之十至 28.875 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.616362 mm。模型邊界：簡支Euler梁、小撓度、靜態均布荷載；不代表列車移動荷載。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: w=50000 N/m; L=26.25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4; calculation: deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.103997 mm. Sensitivity: L, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 28.875 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.616362 mm. Model boundary: Simply supported Euler beam, small deflection and static uniform load; not a moving train-load analysis.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bridge deflection and span sensitivity", which statement holds?
options: 平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達
降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：w=50000 N/m; L=26.25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4。
optionsEn: A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time.
Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored.
Original hypothetical exercise.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：w=50000 N/m; L=26.25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4；計算：deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.103997 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: w=50000 N/m; L=26.25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4; calculation: deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.103997 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bridge deflection and span sensitivity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在已知載重位置量測跨中和支點位移，扣除支承沉陷後對照彎矩圖，並用卸載後讀值檢查是否存在殘留變形。 先以已知荷載校對位移計量程與零點，分別記錄載入卸載路徑及支點運動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure midspan and support movement under known loading, subtract support settlement, compare with the moment diagram, and inspect residual displacement after unloading. Check displacement-sensor range and zero under known loading, recording loading and unloading paths separately from support movement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持截面不變增加跨長，再比較提高慣性矩的補償幅度，說明靜態位移符合預期為何仍不能取代動態驗證。 再以本單元 L 的對照值重算 deflection，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase span while keeping the section fixed, calculate the compensating inertia change, and explain why agreement in static deflection cannot replace dynamic verification. Also recalculate deflection for the alternative L value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：支承鬆動或局部開裂可能改變有效剛度，若把所有位移都當成梁彎曲，校準出的彈性模數就會失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Loose supports and local cracking alter effective stiffness; interpreting all displacement as beam bending produces a misleading calibrated elastic modulus. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在已知載重位置量測跨中和支點位移，扣除支承沉陷後對照彎矩圖，並用卸載後讀值檢查是否存在殘留變形。 先以已知荷載校對位移計量程與零點，分別記錄載入卸載路徑及支點運動。
knowledge.textEn: Measure midspan and support movement under known loading, subtract support settlement, compare with the moment diagram, and inspect residual displacement after unloading. Check displacement-sensor range and zero under known loading, recording loading and unloading paths separately from support movement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保持截面不變增加跨長，再比較提高慣性矩的補償幅度，說明靜態位移符合預期為何仍不能取代動態驗證。 再以本單元 L 的對照值重算 deflection，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Increase span while keeping the section fixed, calculate the compensating inertia change, and explain why agreement in static deflection cannot replace dynamic verification. Also recalculate deflection for the alternative L value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bridge deflection and span sensitivity"?
options: 在已知載重位置量測跨中和支點位移，扣除支承沉陷後對照彎矩圖，並用卸載後讀值檢查是否存在殘留變形。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接
optionsEn: Measure midspan and support movement under known loading, subtract support settlement, compare with the moment diagram, and inspect residual displacement after unloading.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
quiz.explanation: 在已知載重位置量測跨中和支點位移，扣除支承沉陷後對照彎矩圖，並用卸載後讀值檢查是否存在殘留變形。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure midspan and support movement under known loading, subtract support settlement, compare with the moment diagram, and inspect residual displacement after unloading. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bridge deflection and span sensitivity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 支承鬆動或局部開裂可能改變有效剛度，若把所有位移都當成梁彎曲，校準出的彈性模數就會失真。 若卸載後仍有位移，須區分基座滑移與構件殘留變形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Loose supports and local cracking alter effective stiffness; interpreting all displacement as beam bending produces a misleading calibrated elastic modulus. Residual displacement after unloading requires distinguishing fixture slip from permanent structural deformation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在高架跨中與橋端同步量測，辨認橋隧交界的變形來源。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Measure viaduct midspan and ends together to identify movement sources near a bridge-tunnel transition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 支承鬆動或局部開裂可能改變有效剛度，若把所有位移都當成梁彎曲，校準出的彈性模數就會失真。 若卸載後仍有位移，須區分基座滑移與構件殘留變形。
knowledge.textEn: Loose supports and local cracking alter effective stiffness; interpreting all displacement as beam bending produces a misleading calibrated elastic modulus. Residual displacement after unloading requires distinguishing fixture slip from permanent structural deformation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bridge deflection and span sensitivity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
支承鬆動或局部開裂可能改變有效剛度，若把所有位移都當成梁彎曲，校準出的彈性模數就會失真。
兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Loose supports and local cracking alter effective stiffness; interpreting all displacement as beam bending produces a misleading calibrated elastic modulus.
Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them.
quiz.explanation: 支承鬆動或局部開裂可能改變有效剛度，若把所有位移都當成梁彎曲，校準出的彈性模數就會失真。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Loose supports and local cracking alter effective stiffness; interpreting all displacement as beam bending produces a misleading calibrated elastic modulus. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「沉陷差與軌道坡折」如何影響雪梨地鐵西北線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Differential settlement and track kink” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sydney Metro Northwest”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。兩端高差除以基長只給平均坡度，無法描述局部尖峰；需要多點剖面才能辨認曲率與變形長度。 相同端點坡度可以對應完全不同的中間形狀，因此坡度不能單獨表示軌道曲率。測點間距必須小於欲辨認的變形尺度，並將高程誤差相對於基長傳遞到坡度結果。 把過渡段差異沉陷的基長與車輪感受的不平順波長比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沉陷差與軌道坡折」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading. End-to-end difference divided by baseline gives only an average gradient, not a local peak. A spatial profile is needed to identify curvature and deformation length. Identical endpoint gradient can hide very different intermediate shapes, so gradient alone cannot describe track curvature. Survey spacing must resolve the deformation length scale, and elevation uncertainty must be propagated relative to the baseline into the reported gradient. Compare differential-settlement baseline with the irregularity wavelength experienced by wheels. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Differential settlement and track kink” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.0126 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.63 mm/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.0126 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.63 mm/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「沉陷差與軌道坡折」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Differential settlement and track kink”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折
knowledge.text: 均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。兩端高差除以基長只給平均坡度，無法描述局部尖峰；需要多點剖面才能辨認曲率與變形長度。
knowledge.textEn: Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading. End-to-end difference divided by baseline gives only an average gradient, not a local peak.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沉陷差與軌道坡折」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Differential settlement and track kink" is correct?
options: 兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷
兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差
均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。
optionsEn: Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them.
Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias.
Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading.
quiz.explanation: 均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「沉陷差與軌道坡折」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Differential settlement and track kink” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.0126 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.63 mm/m。敏感度：drop 單獨增加百分之十至 0.01386 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.693 mm/m。模型邊界：小變形平均坡度；不計車軌耦合動力或容許軌道幾何。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.0126 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.63 mm/m. Sensitivity: drop, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.01386 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.693 mm/m. Model boundary: Small-deformation average gradient; vehicle-track dynamics and permissible geometry limits are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.0126 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.63 mm/m。敏感度：drop 單獨增加百分之十至 0.01386 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.693 mm/m。模型邊界：小變形平均坡度；不計車軌耦合動力或容許軌道幾何。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.0126 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.63 mm/m. Sensitivity: drop, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.01386 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.693 mm/m. Model boundary: Small-deformation average gradient; vehicle-track dynamics and permissible geometry limits are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「沉陷差與軌道坡折」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

停準誤差標準差小就代表不可能出現固定方向偏移

A small stopping-error standard deviation rules out a persistent directional offset.
Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.0126 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.63 mm/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.0126 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.63 mm/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「沉陷差與軌道坡折」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Differential settlement and track kink” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。 重複觀測同一測點並做閉合檢核，以另一穩定基準核對零點，報告高差與基長各自誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift. Repeat identical points with closure checks, verify zero against another stable reference, and report separate errors for elevation difference and baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：構造端點相同但中間下陷的剖面，與直線坡度模型比較；提出足以辨識沉陷槽寬度的測點間距與複測頻率。 再以本單元 drop 的對照值重算 gradient，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Construct a profile with equal endpoints and an intermediate trough, compare it with a straight-gradient model, and propose spacing and repeat intervals able to resolve the trough. Also recalculate gradient for the alternative drop value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。 重複觀測同一測點並做閉合檢核，以另一穩定基準核對零點，報告高差與基長各自誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift. Repeat identical points with closure checks, verify zero against another stable reference, and report separate errors for elevation difference and baseline.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 構造端點相同但中間下陷的剖面，與直線坡度模型比較；提出足以辨識沉陷槽寬度的測點間距與複測頻率。 再以本單元 drop 的對照值重算 gradient，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Construct a profile with equal endpoints and an intermediate trough, compare it with a straight-gradient model, and propose spacing and repeat intervals able to resolve the trough. Also recalculate gradient for the alternative drop value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「沉陷差與軌道坡折」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Differential settlement and track kink"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。
備援電池開路電壓正常就能保證額定支援時間
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift.
Normal open-circuit battery voltage guarantees the rated backup duration.
quiz.explanation: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「沉陷差與軌道坡折」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Differential settlement and track kink” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 高差異常需先查基點，不能立刻推定路基局部下沉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. An unusual level difference requires a datum check before inferring local earthwork settlement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把過渡段差異沉陷的基長與車輪感受的不平順波長比較。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare differential-settlement baseline with the irregularity wavelength experienced by wheels.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 高差異常需先查基點，不能立刻推定路基局部下沉。
knowledge.textEn: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. An unusual level difference requires a datum check before inferring local earthwork settlement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「沉陷差與軌道坡折」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Differential settlement and track kink" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差
基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias.
A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact.
quiz.explanation: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
